info.description: Multi-tenant SaaS platform for satellite device management. Ingests MO messages from Iridium/Globalstar, manages devices, SOS escalation, dead man's switch, and E2E encryption.

Returns every contact in the caller's tenant. Newest
clients also honour ?kind=<bearer> to narrow to
contacts that have at least one address of the given
kind.

parameters.description: Optional bearer kind filter (SMS, MESHTASTIC, APRS, IRIDIUM_SBD, IRIDIUM_IMT, CELLULAR, TAK, RETICULUM, ZIGBEE, BLE, WEBHOOK, EMAIL, MQTT)
parameters.name: kind

parameters.description: Contact (tenant_id will be overridden by the caller's tenant)
parameters.name: body

get.description:
Streams every contact in the caller's tenant as a
concatenated vCard 4.0 document. X-MESHSAT-*
extensions carry the bearer-kind metadata not covered
by standard TEL/EMAIL.

post.description:
Uploads a CSV file with header row:
`display_name,sms,meshtastic,aprs,email,team,role`.
Unknown columns ignored; missing columns treated as
empty. One contact per data row.

Uploads a .vcf file (Content-Type: text/vcard) and
creates directory_contacts + directory_addresses rows
for each record. X-MESHSAT-* extensions cover the
bearer kinds that standard vCard does not
(MESHTASTIC, APRS, IRIDIUM_SBD/IMT, CELLULAR, TAK,
RETICULUM, ZIGBEE, BLE, WEBHOOK, MQTT) plus team /
role / SIDC / trust-level metadata. Response reports
parsed / imported / errors counts.

parameters.description: vCard 4.0 text (one or more BEGIN/END records)
parameters.name: body

get.description:
Full tenant directory payload with an ECDSA-P256-SHA256
signature over its canonical JSON. Bridges consume via
the directory_push MQTT command (MESHSAT-540) or by
polling this endpoint on reconnect. since is advisory —
v1 always returns the full snapshot; a future delta
endpoint (MESHSAT-540) ships incremental changes.

parameters.description: Hint: only return data if stored version > since
parameters.name: since

get.description: Real-time stream of messages, positions, and alerts. Pass token via ?token= query param or Authorization header.

next_esc_at.description: when to escalate to next tier

device_filter.description: "*" for all, or specific IMEI, or group ID

prev_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the previous entry

birth_verified.description: true if last birth had valid ECDSA signature

key_hex.description: hex-encoded AES-256 key (omitted in listings, passthrough)

max_retries.description: max delivery retries within this tier

wait_sec.description: seconds to wait before escalating to next tier

device_imei.description: device IMEI or "*" for tenant-wide default

dir_sign_pub.description: Hub's ECDSA-P256 directory-signing pubkey (PKIX DER) — bridge pins on first provision [MESHSAT-539]

key_hex.description: hex-encoded AES-256 key (64 hex chars = 32 bytes)

bridge_ids.description: target bridges to push key to

encrypt.description: AES-256-GCM encrypt with device key (default: true if key exists)

scheduled_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp for future delivery (empty = send now)

compress.description: SMAZ2 compress (default false for SMS — human-readable)
Compress enables DEFLATE compression of IP packets before framing.

device_name.description: DeviceName is the TUN device name (e.g., "tun-ugrs0").

enabled.description: Enabled activates the tunnel. Default: false (experimental).

frag_timeout.description:
FragTimeout is how long to wait for all fragments of a packet before
discarding incomplete reassemblies.

hub_address.description: HubAddress is the Hub's IP within the tunnel subnet.

mtu.description: MTU is the IP-level MTU for the TUN device (not SBD MTU).

sbd_mtu.description:
SBDMTU is the maximum SBD payload size per frame. Iridium MT = 270,
MO = 340. Uses the smaller value (MT) by default for bidirectional safety.

tunnel_subnet.description: TunnelSubnet is the CIDR for the tunnel network.
